criteria.contract: An explicit new-head request renews the same returned garrison using a new case issuer without rewriting initial military terms, old commands, letters or proofs

Only a present actual successor head may request handover after known closure, return of custody and supplies; active, remote, stale and forged handovers are refused A present household member, including the retired head, may explicitly request a fresh successor-issued offer/permission without silently changing personal service; prior custody still blocks takeover.
Repeated loans, casualties, food use and depot transfers retain one physical lifetime ledger and no duplicated troops, stocks or command grants
Current and historical military issuers, permissions, physical reports and old inquiries retain the correct case/time; personal service remains separate
Normal entry and save/recovery/future equality, old save byte compatibility and headless Node3D data are checked separately from appearance acceptance

limits: Current selected returned garrison only. Explicit successor-issued new military case, same lifetime physical ledger, no automatic personal service. Original terms/commands/proofs/letters/food/casualties retained. No active army takeover, archived garrison issuer handover across house switches, general NPC garrison reissue, old administrative delegation reauthorization, treaty/hostage assumption, death or contested succession. Full3403/GUI NOT_RUN.
